subject.title: fix(ci): bound plugin-npm-release git fetch and npm publish with timeout

question: Should plugin npm releases fail after 120 seconds for Git fetches and 300 seconds for npm publish attempts, rather than consuming the full workflow job timeout?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and aligned with prior workflow hardening, but these deadlines intentionally alter release failure behavior and need the responsible owner to accept the operational tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Accept the 120-second fetch and 300-second publish budgets after a current-base merge refresh confirms no release logic changed.

options.title: Adjust the budgets
options.body: Choose different operation-specific deadlines if observed release environments need more time while retaining termination and bounded failure behavior.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep the existing job-timeout behavior if the release owner does not want operation-level failure limits in this workflow.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Accept the 120-second fetch and 300-second publish budgets after a current-base merge refresh confirms no release logic changed.
